chapter: Touring and the future of the hall
title: Philosophy of the hall, audiences, the 1963 New England tour, Japan, and the future
summary: A long answer on representing the music, the hall's size and crowds, the summer 1963 tour with George Lewis, the Japan tour, the aging musicians, touring, and college audiences.
